interpretation.reference: Same N64 fixed grid and initial state, dt cap 2.5e-5; this reference is finite, not the exact semi-discrete solution.
interpretation.order: Adjacent L1 cap-ratio slopes only, no prospective physical temporal accuracy gate exists. Preserve negative/noise-dominated values without claiming physical accuracy orders.
interpretation.gauge: A components are total A in each profile gauge; phi is cleaning scalar. They are reported separately from physical B. Profiles are compared only to references in their own gauge.
interpretation.frozen_C1: Frozen initial div(A) and sound speed retained in endpoint cleaning stage; this packet does not replace the independent gauge-mode test or establish general second-order time accuracy.
interpretation.time_history: Only aggregate accepted min/max/step counts, rejection counts, root sequence and output-time diagnostics are available. Clock-model agreement is not a recorded full per-step dt trace.

finite_reference_linear_error_example.assumption: If the leading same-grid error is C*dt with fixed C, subtraction of a nonzero dt_ref gives these apparent slopes; this is an illustration, not a fitted mechanism proof.

interpretation.roundoff_components: Regular travelling bx in both profiles is about 1.5e-16; regular standing signal bx is about 2e-15. Their recorded positive/negative slopes are roundoff diagnostics, not accuracy orders.
